data.name: Midhat
data.gender_notes: Midhat is used as a unisex name in Islamic naming traditions.
data.long_meaning: The one who is generous and bestows beauty, grace and kindness upon others. The name Midhat carries the meaning “Grace, Beauty, Generosity” and is chosen by families in Islamic traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Arabic tradition and is also used in Arabic. Parents who choose Midhat usually hope their child will grow to embody grace, beauty, generosity and live with faith, good character and purpose.
data.spiritual_meaning: To inspire love, kindness and beauty in others
data.etymology: Midhat belongs to the Arabic linguistic tradition and is used in Islamic naming. Its recorded meaning is “Grace, Beauty, Generosity.”
data.numerology_meaning: In Pythagorean numerology the letters of Midhat total 1, giving a life-path number of 1. Number 1 is linked with Sun and with the qualities of leadership, independence and initiative.

data.cultural_impact: The name Midhat carries a deep sense of honor and respect for the Arabic language and culture. It is often associated with the Arabic notion of hospitality and kindness, reflecting the importance and value placed on acts of generosity and kindness in Arab societies. In addition, the name is also reflective of the beautiful poetic heritage of the Arabic language.
data.spiritual_significance: In Islamic tradition, the name Midhat holds significant spiritual meaning as it suggests the idea of bestowing blessings and kindness upon others, being a reflection of God's mercy and compassion towards humanity. Midhat also signifies the act of seeking and reflecting beauty, both in the external world and in one's own heart, which is encouraged in Islamic teachings as a means to draw closer to God. Overall, the name Midhat inspires us to cultivate a generous and kind spirit, embodies the quest for beauty and grace, and ultimately, reflects the essence of God's divine attributes.
data.spiritual_symbolism: The meaning "Grace, Beauty, Generosity" symbolizes The one who is generous and bestows beauty, grace and kindness upon others. In Islamic spirituality, bearing the name Midhat serves as a constant reminder of one's spiritual aspirations and connection to Islamic values of grace, beauty, generosity.
